Corin sought help from the mental health department at HMP Dartmoor. He revealed to a nurse in the mental health department the fact that he had recently deliberately harmed himself and made this fact known to other mental health workers. An ACCT was not opened despite the provisions in Chapter 2 of PSI 64 / 2011 which made the opening of an ACCT in these circumstances mandatory.
